expeditions.name: Cairn Line Walk
expeditions.description: Every ridge up here looks like the last one, and the locals navigate by which cairn is leaning. Walk the line from the third switchback to the saddle, straighten what has drifted, and write down what has gone missing since spring.

expeditions.name: Hayloft Turn
expeditions.description: The whole loft has to come down, get turned, and go back up before the damp gets into the middle of it. It is four hours of work, one hour of which is waking the farmhand who is asleep in it.

expeditions.name: Courier Relay
expeditions.description: Through-road parcels change hands at the leaning cairn and nowhere else. Take the westbound sack, hand over the eastbound, sign both books — and do not read the docket on the one that has been going back and forth since March.

expeditions.name: Orchard Dawn Pick
expeditions.description: The valley apples ripen toward the first light, which means the entire crop comes good within about six hours of each other and nobody in four generations has solved this. Pick from full dark until the sun clears the ridge.

expeditions.name: Quarry Night Shift
expeditions.description: The gravel beds are still worked after dark by a harvester nobody has switched off in nine years. It does not need help and it does not want conversation. It needs somebody standing where it can see them, or it stops.

expeditions.name: Circus Load-Out
expeditions.description: The show strikes its tent at midnight and the road down is the one nobody warns you about. Walk the wagons to the flat, keep the ringmaster talking the whole way, and check the count at the bottom against the count at the top.

expeditions.name: Bog Button Dredge
expeditions.description: The bog at the bottom of the switchbacks pays the witch's rent in lost buttons and old coins, and it has been collecting since before there was a road to lose things off. Wade the shallows on a falling water table and bring up what it is willing to part with.

expeditions.name: Dusk Roll Call
expeditions.description: The gravekeeper reads every name on the wall between dusk and the other side, out loud, once a season. It takes six hours and it cannot be done alone: somebody has to stand at the far end and answer 'here' for the ones who cannot.

expeditions.name: Ballast Drop Watch
expeditions.description: Cloud-kingdom freighters shed weight over the foothills because the tariff is calculated at the pass and not a mile before it. Be out under it all night with a lamp and a chalk line, mark where each one lands, and reach it before the farmers do.

expeditions.name: Off-Season Drill
expeditions.description: The ridge patrol keeps no off-season, which is precisely how the ridge patrol stays the ridge patrol. Eighteen hours of switchbacks and tall grass, being corrected about your footing by somebody carrying a spear and no opinions whatsoever about your feelings.
